learning_outcomes.text: Distinguish retrieval quality from answer quality in a RAG system
Define retrieval metrics (e.g. recall, precision) at a working level
Assess answer grounding and faithfulness to retrieved context
Build a small evaluation set and interpret results
Diagnose whether a failure is a retrieval or a generation problem

integrative_case: A team's RAG assistant gives a wrong answer; build a small evaluation set, measure retrieval and grounding separately, and determine whether the fault lies in retrieval or generation before changing the system.
